thread.subject: Vendor security questionnaire - please complete sections 4 and 7

message.text:
Hello,

As part of onboarding Northwind as a supplier, please complete sections 4 (subprocessors) and 7 (contractual commitments) of the attached-style questionnaire. Section 7 asks for your standard liability cap, your data breach notification window, and whether you will sign our DPA unamended.

We need this back within 10 business days.

Brightline Retail - Vendor Risk
